name: googleanalytics
title: Google Analytics
blurb: Puts Google's tag on every page once a site connects Google Analytics (Connections, Marketing), only for visitors who said yes to Statistics. Before a yes nothing is sent to Google at all. It needs the Cookie consent plugin, which asks the question and makes the browser keep to the answer.

www.googletagmanager.com.purpose: Counts visits and what people do here.
